scientific_integrity: The stated exact proofs are analytic; finite numerical tests only corroborate formulas. Sharp frame bounds were already determined in 2023 and are not presented as new.
scientific_limitations: Symmetric unnormalized Laplace window only, rectangular redundancy-two Gabor lattice, fixed-parameter asymptotics; no uniform crossing expansion. Unindexed equivalent spectral-law calculation remains a historical priority risk.
title: Two singularity types and a cubic crossover in the Laplace Gabor spectral distribution
